parameters.help_en:
The OSS address of the import file. It is a JSON object. Example: `{"Bucket":"example-bucket","Location":"oss-cn-shanghai","Object":"example.txt"}`.

The region of the OSS bucket must be the same as the region where MPS is deployed
parameters.help_zh:
导库⽂件的OSS地址，JSON对象。例如：`{"Bucket":"example-bucket","Location":"oss-cn-shanghai","Object":"example.txt"}`。

OSS的地域需要与当前MPS所在地域保持一致
parameters.name: input

parameters.help_en: The ID of the MPS queue. You can obtain the ID from the MPS console > Global Settings > MPS Queues page. It is used to distinguish services and bind message notifications. If you do not specify this parameter, the default MPS queue is used and no message notification is bound
parameters.help_zh: 管道ID，可以通过MPS控制台 > 全局设置 > 管道获取。⽤于区分业务，绑定消息通知。若不传，则使⽤默认管道，不绑定消息通知
parameters.name: pipeline_id

parameters.help_en:
The import configuration. It is a JSON object. Example: `{"SaveType":"onlysave"}`. `SaveType` specifies the storage type. Valid values:

save: Deduplicates and imports data.

onlysave: Imports data without deduplication
parameters.help_zh:
导库配置，JSON对象。 例如：`{"SaveType":"onlysave"}`。其中`SaveType`表示存储类型，取值包括：

save：去重入库。

onlysave：仅入库
parameters.name: fp_import_config

parameters.help_en: The custom user data. It supports Chinese and English characters, digits, and special characters. Maximum length: 128 bytes
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义数据，支持中英文、数字、特殊符号。最大长度128字节
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DNA library. It is used to import text features in batches. A library can process only one import job in parallel. You can obtain the ID from the response parameters of https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170149.html
parameters.help_zh: DNA库ID，⽤于批量导⼊⽂本特征，⼀个库只能并⾏处理⼀个导库任务。可以从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170149.html的返回参数中获取
parameters.name: fp_db_id

JobId.description_en: The ID of the batch import job. Save this ID for subsequent API calls
JobId.description_zh: 批量导库作业ID。建议您保存此ID便于后续调用其他接口时使用
